rules.name: Core Curriculum
rules.desc:
Students must enroll in CSRE 100 or NATIVEAM 100 before they can declare the minor in Native American Studies.

Please note that students are encouraged to begin the declaration process as soon as possible. The minor will be tagged as “pending” until CCSRE confirms enrollment in one of the gateway courses.

rules.name: Native American Studies Electives (20 units)

children.name: Further elective, Native American Studies or up to 5 units of DAAAS, ASNAMST, CHILATST, CSRE or JEWISHST

rules.desc:
Native American Studies minors must complete the remaining units of their 30-unit minimum with elective coursework in Native American Studies, with the exception below.
Native American Studies minors may count up to 5 units of Department of African and African American Studies (DAAAS), Asian American Studies (ASNAMST), Chicana/o-Latina/o Studies (CHILATST), Comparative Studies in Race and Ethnicity (CSRE), or Jewish Studies (JEWISHST) courses toward their degree in Native American Studies.

rules.name: At most one S/NC class, and only as an elective

grading: A minimum grade of C- is required for a student to count a class towards the Core Curriculum, including the Gateway and Minor Core. Additional units toward the major require a passing grade of D- or above. Student may count 1 class with Satisfactory/No Credit (SNC) grading basis toward Additional Units.
policies: No more than 5 units of petitioned courses that are not listed under CCSRE or cross-listed with CCSRE may be applied to electives in the Native American Studies minor. Students who wish to petition a course must fill out and submit a course petition form for the CCSRE Academic Programs team to review within one month of completing their annual degree audit meeting with the CCSRE Student Services Officer.
transferPolicy: Up to ten units of external credit may be applied toward elective coursework in the minor.
reviewNotes: The audit checks CSRE 100 and NATIVEAM 100, each letter graded with a C- or better, and 20 units of electives: at least 15 units of Native American Studies courses, and up to 5 units from other CCSRE programs (DAAAS, ASNAMST, CHILATST, CSRE or JEWISHST), for 30 units in all. Units past 5 from those other programs, and petitioned courses from outside CCSRE past 5 units, do not count. Checked by hand: that only one class is S/NC, and only as an elective, and that at most 10 units are external credit.
